$comment: Sapphire Nitro Glow V3 (address 0x28), worked out by hand from OpenRGB d4798c12 SapphireNitroGlowV3Controller.cpp / RGBController_SapphireNitroGlowV3.cpp, not by running the plugin. Each write is [register, value] (SMBus Write Byte Data to 0x28; on ADL the register is the first data byte). scan_probe is the presence read of TestForSapphireGPUController (offset 0). init_reads is what the plugin keeps for Shutdown(): colour R G B, external control, mode. init_writes is DeviceUpdateMode() for Static: external control 0, then mode CUSTOM 0x06. frame_123456 is DeviceUpdateLEDs() for #123456 (SetColor: 0x1A R, 0x1B G, 0x1C B). shutdown_restore writes the startup colour, then the mode, then external control; shutdown_unreadable is shutdownColor #000000 in mode CUSTOM, used when a startup read failed.
